title: Update mattn/go-runewidth for improved startup performance
body:
### Issue Description

When doing some startup performance testing of podman run, i noticed that (in my podman 6.1.0 build) that mattn/go-runewidth was taking a lot of time running the initializer.


### Steps to reproduce the issue

This can be seen with inittrace=1:

$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @10 ms, 32 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @10 ms, 22 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @12 ms, 45 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @13 ms, 26 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @10 ms, 22 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @12 ms, 38 ms clock, 57352 bytes, 53 allocs


### Describe the results you received

In the runs this takes at least 20 msec

### Describe the results you expected

If I update mattn/go-runewidth to 0.0.31 I get:

$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @7.1 ms, 0.059 ms clock, 48 bytes, 3 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @5.8 ms, 0.054 ms clock, 48 bytes, 3 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @4.6 ms, 0.044 ms clock, 48 bytes, 3 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @4.0 ms, 0.027 ms clock, 48 bytes, 3 allocs
$ GODEBUG=inittrace=1 podman run  --rm registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true 2>&1 | grep rune
init github.com/mattn/go-runewidth @6.4 ms, 0.063 ms clock, 48 bytes, 3 allocs

This is due to it now lazily initializing the more costly tables. I
think we should update this dependency as this is a simple change that
saves at least 20 msec at startup.

I filed an issue instead of a PR because I don't really know how dependency updates are handled in podman.

comments.body:
renovate handles dependency updates for direct dependencies

github.com/mattn/go-runewidth is not a direct dep but an indirect one from github.com/vbauerster/mpb/v8 so normally it waits for an update of it there.

That said there is nothing that would prevent us from bumping the indirect dep directly if there are important fixes
actually  github.com/mattn/go-runewidth v0.0.31 is already updated on main and v6.2 so this can be closed
